fields.v: Partly (0.5): mixed results acknowledged (curated library regresses on GPT-5.5 and on SWE-Bench Pro except GPT-5.4 mini; baselines regress on GPT-5.5; gains from skills are heavy-tailed and moderate on average), but small online gains (0.9-2.7 pp, no variance or significance tests) are presented as consistent improvement, and SkillsVote's own Hard-split regressions on Terminal-Bench 2.0 (e.g. -6.7 pp for GPT-5.2) are not discussed
fields.quote: Offline reuse helps in several settings, but the gains vary across frozen libraries, benchmarks, and backbones.
fields.why: The authors do report and discuss negative and mixed offline results and baseline regressions, so No (0) may be too strict; the unaddressed online Hard-split regressions argue for Partly rather than Yes.
fields.doubt: Os autores reconhecem resultados mistos (biblioteca curada piora no GPT-5.5 e no SWE-Bench Pro; ganhos 'pesados na cauda'), mas chamam 'consistentes' a ganhos pequenos sem testes e não comentam a queda de -6,7 pp no Hard. Lê §4.2 e §4.3.2 (págs. 7-9) e decide entre Não e Parcial em Q9.
